purpose: Map the #502 Track-B pre-fixed stress axes (B2) to real parser v4 fields, and record which axes have enough canonical outer-train support to be usable in B1 (the actual OOF subgroup evaluation). Thresholds below are rules, not values -- values must be computed per outer fold from that fold's train rows only by scripts/audit_train_only_stress_subgroup_support.py.

axes.source: computed inline in scripts/audit_train_only_stress_subgroup_support.py, same rule as sample__mutated_gene_count (src/open_cancer/mutation_features.py:36,348) and the EXP-516 loader (scripts/run_exp516_burden_weighted_sample_weight.py:73-95): count of gene cells in a row with at least one whitespace-separated token whose upper-cased form is not 'WT'.
axes.threshold_rule: np.quantile(outer_train_values, [0.10, 0.90]) computed independently per outer fold

axes.source: src/open_cancer/parser_v4_semantic_counts.py::FittedParserV4SemanticCountFamily.transform (stateless family, target-independent, safe to compute once on the full frame; only the bucket definition needs to be fold-local).
axes.threshold_rule: presence only (no quantile) -- most families are near-zero support on train (see reports/analysis/local_public_gap notes and PROJECT_CONTEXT.md parser lineage section), so a >0/==0 split is the only bucketing that keeps both sides non-degenerate for most families. Per-family outer-train fold counts must still be audited before B1 uses any specific family; families with < 2 positive rows in an outer-train fold are unusable for that fold.
axes.note: deletion/insertion/delins/duplication_candidate families are known near-zero on train (see PROJECT_CONTEXT.md Local-Public gap discussion) -- expect these to fail the per-fold support check; the audit script reports the actual counts rather than assuming.

axes.source: src/open_cancer/parser_v4_semantic_counts.py (route == 'unresolved' OR parse_status == 'unresolved' on RoutedProteinMutation from src/open_cancer/mutation_parser_contract.py). Note this counter also folds in substitution-route tokens with event_type == 'other_unmappable' (the mapping.get(...) None fallback in _increment_event) -- it is not identical to axis 'nonstandard_notation' below, which isolates only the other_unmappable subset.
axes.threshold_rule: presence only; add outer-train Q95+ bucket only if the audit script finds enough >0 support per fold

axes.source: computed inline, same rule as sample__missing_gene_count (src/open_cancer/mutation_features.py:39,336): count of empty-string gene cells in a row. PROJECT_CONTEXT.md notes test has 237 empty cells total; train support must be checked, not assumed.
axes.threshold_rule: presence only; add outer-train Q95+ bucket only if the audit script finds enough >0 support per fold

axes.source: same field as mutation_burden axis, no separate feature exists.
axes.threshold_rule: fixed integer cuts, no quantile needed

axes.field: per-row count of gene cells with non-empty group_gene_cell_annotations(cell).likely_groups
axes.note: Already measured and committed: reports/analysis/isoform_annotation_multiplicity/audit.json shows train.cells_with_likely_multiplicity = 0 out of 218,893 non-WT train cells, vs 4,666 on test. Zero train support -- cannot define a non-degenerate train-fold bucket. Excluded from B1; kept here only as a documented zero-support axis per #502's 'do not invent categories that do not exist' rule.

sub_axes.name: long_inserted_peptide
sub_axes.field: insertion/delins route payload length (inserted_length on ParsedProteinInsertion / ProteinDuplicationSemanticResult in src/open_cancer/protein_duplication_semantics.py; net_length_change on ProteinDelinsSemanticResult in src/open_cancer/protein_delins_semantics.py)
sub_axes.note: route_protein_mutation over the full train set returns 0 insertion and 0 delins tokens (train route counts: substitution 244912, frameshift 9833, range_replacement 239, unresolved 177, deletion 3; see also reports/analysis/protein_delins_semantics/README.md and reports/analysis/protein_duplication_semantics/README.md, and the parser-v4 lineage section of PROJECT_CONTEXT.md). Zero train support -- excluded from B1.

sub_axes.name: nonstandard_notation
sub_axes.field: per-row count of parsed events with event_type == 'other_unmappable'
sub_axes.source: src/open_cancer/mutation_parser_contract.py (_NON_PROTEIN_PARTIAL, _AMBIGUOUS_DOUBLE_STOP regexes), documented at PROJECT_CONTEXT.md's '-762fs / *261*' partial-terminal-semantics passage and reports/analysis/partial_terminal_semantics/README.md. Not exposed as its own sample__parser_v4_* counter (it is folded into unresolved_count today) -- computed with a small dedicated loop in the audit script.
sub_axes.threshold_rule: presence only; train-wide count is small (~174-177 tokens across 6,201 rows per the parser lineage audits), so the audit script must confirm each outer-train fold still has non-trivial >0 support before B1 uses this axis for that fold.
